details:
Q1
What should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or script in this repo (RECOMMENDED)
B. Repository documentation (README, runbooks, or comments)
C. CI/CD or GitHub Actions behavior
D. Something else; specify the exact file, workflow, or feature
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or broken behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a new feature
C. Improve reliability, validation, or error handling
D. Improve developer experience, readability, or maintainability
Q3
How will we know the task is done?
Choices:
A. Match a specific expected behavior you describe (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make an existing failing workflow/test pass
C. Update docs or output text in a specific way
D. Apply a general cleanup with no strict acceptance criteria
